falsification_conditions.condition: The asset's price closes above the 200-day moving average by 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained breakout above a key long-term trendline would invalidate the 'hold' signal, indicating a confirmed bullish trend rather than uncertainty.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume exceeds 200% of the 30-day average volume on two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sudden extreme volume spikes would contradict the 'hold' signal, suggesting a high-probability breakout or blowoff event is already underway.

falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score increases to 60 or higher within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score surpassing 60 would directly contradict the current 'hold' signal, proving the system's failure to detect an imminent blowoff top.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
